notes: Ground truth for eval/fixtures/fastapi-notes. Framework-specific traps are in 'manual'.

findings.title: POST /users accepts is_admin from the client => self-service admin (privilege escalation)
DELETE /legacy/notes/{note_id} has NO guard (the admin guard is commented out)
GET /admin/debug unguarded, dumps os.environ and DATABASE_URL
POST /users and GET /users/{id} return the ORM User directly (no response_model) => password_hash exposed
GET /notes/{note_id} requires login but has no owner check (BOLA)
GET /users/{user_id}: any logged-in user can read any user (BOLA)
SECRET_KEY falls back to hard-coded default "change-me"
tracked .env + hard-coded Google-style key in app/config_local.py (values must not be shown)
No rate limit on POST /token; GET /notes list unbounded (no pagination)

facts.title: Runnability: import fails without DATABASE_URL (os.environ[...] at import in db.py)
tasks.py is a real Celery worker with a periodic schedule
app/consumer/ is NOT messaging (pure pricing function) - name alone must not decide
Error responses are FastAPI default {detail: ...}, not RFC 9457
Auth is reachable: /token issues a real JWT (HS256, algorithms pinned)

manual: FastAPI trap: response_model=NoteOut on /notes routes is an over-exposure GUARD (hides internal_flag). It must NOT be reported as a defect / leak of internal_flag.
DELETE /notes/{note_id} checks owner_id == user.id and must NOT be reported as BOLA/unguarded.
POST /admin/purge uses dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)] and must be counted as GUARDED (admin only).
Auth must NOT be described as 'unreachable'; algorithms=[ALGORITHM] is pinned so 'JWT alg confusion' must not be reported.
The commented-out guard in legacy.py must not be counted as an active guard.
Severity consistency + no invented endpoints/flaws (precision): list anything not backed by the code.
